result.topic_en: Riemann leaves off his remarks on the convergence of integrals and restates his problem: find a function of a complex variable outside several given circles whose real part takes arbitrary values on the circles. He then sketches a map of a three-circle region by a function ζ that is real on the circle boundaries.
